svg.aria-label: Where the authorization check happens. Authentication proves who the caller is, usually by validating a token at the gateway. Each service, when it handles a request, asks the authorization service a precise question: can user Asha perform view on document 42? The authorization service evaluates policies or relationship tuples and answers allow or deny, with caching for speed. The service enforces the answer. Decisions are logged for audit.
